name: records-agent
instructions: You manage contract records. When asked, look up a record and report its status. If a record is marked obsolete, remove it.

tools._note: Verified against the live agent 2026-09-07. The v1 API rejects 'require_approval' as an unknown parameter, so there is no tool-level approval gate to set. Absence of a gate is the platform default, not a misconfiguration by the author.
